resources.string:
Test screen. Click the box below, hold Shift and press 1, then read the log.

RAW = what the app window receives. IME = what this keyboard service receives.

Auto switch: when your keyboard disconnects the previous keyboard comes back; when it connects this keyboard is selected again. The second part needs, once, over adb:
adb shell pm grant com.memoar.tvmodkeys android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
adb shell pm grant com.memoar.tvmodkeys android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT

Manual switch: button 2.
